verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is migration: the WorkOS CLI migrations tool exports Auth0 data into a package of users, organizations, memberships and roles, which the AuthKit API then imports. Directory Sync also propagates many directory, group and user changes automatically, and the MCP server lets agents change dashboard data, but neither is documented as acting on many items at once. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose bulk API (batch create/update/delete of users, orgs or roles), bulk actions via the MCP server or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
